title: Saved session (rtm-project-1.0)
description: Everything an enumerator needs to continue later: the assignment, every event logged so far (with the private parts), earlier logs loaded for the performance view, and the view state. File name: {enumerator_id}_project_R{round, two digits}.json, or with _{date}_{HHMM} added when the browser cannot overwrite a file. It holds names and phone numbers: keep it in the enumerator's own folder. When the session came from a protected assignment, the file is protected too (rtm-sealed-1.0).

dials.description: Rows from the enumerator's own earlier exports, as read (CSV columns as text).

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the whole file without this field.
